description: Machine-readable inventory of TypeScript audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or the codebase shows mixed adherence to a soft check.
statusTaxonomy.violation: Concrete code or configuration breaks the invariant.

enrichmentFlags.description: Run tsc --noEmit and use the compiler output to enrich the static findings.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns error redaction and catch-variable typing; useUnknownInCatchVariables overlaps.
Owns component and form-level patterns; state-machine and form-validation checks overlap.

checks.title: strict: true
checks.expectation: The strict family is enabled wholesale via the strict flag.
checks.violationSignal: strict is false, or strict is absent and individual strict-family flags are missing.

checks.title: noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled
checks.expectation: noUncheckedIndexedAccess distinguishes array[i]: T from array[i]: T | undefined.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false.

checks.title: exactOptionalPropertyTypes enabled
checks.expectation: exactOptionalPropertyTypes distinguishes prop?: T from prop: T | undefined.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false.

checks.title: noImplicitReturns enabled
checks.expectation: noImplicitReturns catches functions that fall off the end without returning when their type says they should.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false.

checks.title: noFallthroughCasesInSwitch enabled
checks.expectation: noFallthroughCasesInSwitch catches missing break or return in switch cases.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false.

checks.title: useUnknownInCatchVariables enabled
checks.expectation: Catch variables default to unknown, not any.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false.

checks.title: noImplicitOverride enabled
checks.expectation: Class methods that override a parent must use the override keyword.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing in a class-using codebase.

checks.title: isolatedModules enabled
checks.expectation: isolatedModules is enabled for projects using a per-file-transpiling bundler such as Vite, esbuild, swc, or Bun.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is missing or false in a project using one of those bundlers.

checks.title: skipLibCheck is a deliberate choice
checks.expectation: skipLibCheck is set explicitly to true or false, showing the choice was made.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is absent and the version-dependent default applies.

checks.title: target and module appropriate
checks.expectation: target matches the runtime and module is ESNext, NodeNext, or Preserve rather than CommonJS for browser code.
checks.violationSignal: target is ES5 or older for a modern-only project, or module is mismatched against the resolution model.

checks.title: moduleResolution set explicitly
checks.expectation: moduleResolution is Bundler or NodeNext, set explicitly rather than defaulting.
checks.violationSignal: The flag is absent.

checks.title: Composite or project references for monorepos
checks.expectation: Monorepos use TypeScript project references so type-checks scale across packages.
checks.violationSignal: A multi-package project has no project references.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is not a monorepo.

checks.title: any usage is rare
checks.expectation: The total any annotation count per file is at or below the threshold.
checks.violationSignal: Files exceed the per-file threshold.

checks.title: unknown preferred over any for opaque values
checks.expectation: unknown appears as the safe alternative to any when typing genuinely opaque shapes.
checks.violationSignal: A codebase with substantial any usage and zero unknown.

checks.title: @ts-ignore replaced by @ts-expect-error with description
checks.expectation: No @ts-ignore directives remain; all suppressions are @ts-expect-error with a justification on the same or adjacent line.
checks.violationSignal: Any @ts-ignore in source.

checks.title: No @ts-nocheck at file level
checks.expectation: No file disables type checking entirely.
checks.violationSignal: Any @ts-nocheck at the top of a source file.

checks.title: Type assertions are rare
checks.expectation: The total as assertion count per file is at or below the threshold, excluding as const.
checks.violationSignal: Files exceed the per-file threshold.

checks.title: Non-null assertions are rare
checks.expectation: The total non-null assertion count per file is at or below the threshold.
checks.violationSignal: Files exceed the per-file threshold.

checks.title: No Function type
checks.expectation: Specific function signatures are used rather than the unsafe Function type.
checks.violationSignal: Any Function annotation in source.

checks.title: No Object type
checks.expectation: Record<string, unknown>, a specific shape, or lowercase object is used rather than the Object type.
checks.violationSignal: Any Object annotation in source.

checks.title: No primitive wrapper types
checks.expectation: string, number, and boolean are used rather than the wrapper-object types String, Number, Boolean.
checks.violationSignal: Any wrapper-type annotation in source.

checks.title: No empty interfaces
checks.expectation: Interfaces declare at least one member or extend another type.
checks.violationSignal: interface Foo {} declarations.

checks.title: Discriminated unions for state machines
checks.expectation: Multi-stage state is modelled as a discriminated union rather than multiple booleans or wide objects with optional fields.
checks.violationSignal: Multi-state shapes hand-rolled with several optional fields and no discriminant.

checks.title: Branded or nominal types for IDs
checks.expectation: Identifier types are branded so the compiler distinguishes them even though both carry string at runtime.
checks.violationSignal: Identifier types declared as bare string aliases.

checks.title: as const for literal preservation
checks.expectation: Configuration objects, route lists, and similar literal values use as const to preserve narrow literal types.
checks.violationSignal: Patterns where as const would tighten inference and is missing.

checks.title: Utility types preferred over hand-rolled
checks.expectation: Built-in utility types are used rather than hand-rolling equivalents.
checks.violationSignal: Hand-rolled mapped types that duplicate a built-in utility.

checks.title: Generic constraints used
checks.expectation: Generic parameters operated on with property access or indexing carry extends constraints.
checks.violationSignal: Bare T generics whose body operates on the parameter assuming a shape.

checks.title: Conditional types used judiciously
checks.expectation: Conditional types in application code are bounded and not nested deeper than the threshold.
checks.violationSignal: Nested conditional types deeper than the threshold.

checks.title: Runtime validation library installed
checks.expectation: A runtime validation library is present in a project that performs network requests, parses JSON, or reads form, URL, or storage data.
checks.violationSignal: No validation library is present in such a project.

checks.title: Network response data validated
checks.expectation: Network responses are parsed through a validator before being typed, or use a type-safe layer such as tRPC or GraphQL Code Generator.
checks.violationSignal: Network responses cast directly with as or implicitly typed without runtime validation.

checks.title: JSON.parse results validated
checks.expectation: JSON.parse outputs are validated, not typed by direct assertion.
checks.violationSignal: JSON.parse(...) as MyType patterns.

checks.title: Form data validated
checks.expectation: Forms validate input with the form library's schema integration or a standalone validator.
checks.violationSignal: Form data passed straight to a typed handler with no validator.

checks.title: URL parameters validated
checks.expectation: Router-extracted params are validated before being typed as anything stricter than string or string[].
checks.violationSignal: URL parameters cast to specific types or assumed narrower than their actual runtime type.

checks.title: localStorage and sessionStorage reads validated
checks.expectation: Storage reads are parsed and validated before being typed.
checks.violationSignal: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('key')!) patterns with no validator.

checks.title: Environment variables validated
checks.expectation: Environment-variable access goes through a validated configuration module rather than direct scattered reads.
checks.violationSignal: Direct process.env.X reads in feature code rather than a validated config module.
